cards.meaning: at the end of the day / when you get down to the root of it
cards.example: 归根结底，Kimi K3的效率提升到底是会减少电力需求，还是会刺激更多算力涌入，现在还不好说。
cards.examplePinyin: guī gēn jié dǐ, Kimi K3 de xiàolǜ tíshēng dàodǐ shì huì jiǎnshǎo diànlì xūqiú, háishì huì cìjī gèng duō suànlì yǒngrù, xiànzài hái bù hǎo shuō.
cards.exampleMeaning: At the end of the day, whether Kimi K3's efficiency gain will actually reduce power demand, or just draw in even more compute, is still hard to say.
cards.note: Formal/书面语 register, common in financial commentary and current-affairs analysis. Near-synonym contrast with 总的来说 (a loose, casual summary): 归根结底 carries analytical weight, implying you've walked through surface-level detail to reach the real core underneath — that's why financial reporting reaches for it more often.
cards.tiesTo: Deep Dive — whether Kimi K3's attention-mechanism efficiency gain blunts or accelerates AI data-center power demand

cards.meaning: closely, intimately connected / bound up with each other
cards.example: 霍尔木兹海峡的过路费谈判，跟全球油价的走势息息相关。
cards.examplePinyin: Huò'ěrmùzī hǎixiá de guòlùfèi tánpàn, gēn quánqiú yóujià de zǒushì xī xī xiāng guān.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Hormuz Strait toll-fee negotiations are closely tied to the direction of global oil prices.
cards.note: Four-character idiom used when two things look unrelated on the surface but are actually deeply intertwined. Near-synonym contrast with 有关 (casual, vague — just says some connection exists): 息息相关 is much stronger, stressing the two are inseparable and that a change in one guarantees an effect on the other.
cards.tiesTo: World/Markets throughline — Hormuz toll-fee mechanics tied to the global oil-price slide, and grid stability tied to Texas's data-center interconnection freeze

cards.meaning: to subside, recede, gradually fade away (storm, illness, anger)
cards.example: Humupa na ang bagyong Maymay pagkalabas nito sa Northern Luzon, mula bagyo tungong depresyon tropikal.
cards.exampleMeaning: Storm Maymay subsided after it exited Northern Luzon, weakening from a tropical storm into a tropical depression.
cards.note: More specific than humina (already taught) — humina is a general decrease in strength for any subject, while humupa carries the sense of gradually receding until almost gone, like floodwater or a storm subsiding. Emphasizes the process of ebbing out, not just a weaker state.
cards.tiesTo: Philippines weather — Tropical Storm Maymay/Kujira weakening and exiting Luzon

cards.meaning: to advance, push forward (an agenda, proposal, or goal) with real energy
cards.example: Isinulong ni Pangulong Marcos ang dalawampu't apat na priyoridad na panukalang batas sa ikaapat na pagpupulong ng LEDAC.
cards.exampleMeaning: President Marcos pushed forward twenty-four priority bills at the fourth LEDAC meeting.
cards.note: Near-synonym contrast with itaguyod (to champion/support): itaguyod is about supporting or defending a proposal as it's advanced by others, while isulong carries the sense of personally pulling it forward — more apt when the speaker is the one actively driving the agenda, as with Marcos and the LEDAC bills.
cards.tiesTo: Philippines politics — Marcos convening the 4th LEDAC meeting and locking in a 24-bill legislative agenda
